models.capabilities: Images/video; 32 combined media parts; 256K context; deep thinking; text, JSON object or JSON Schema output.

seed_audio_understand.selection: This tool has no per-call `model` argument. `SEED_AUDIO_UNDERSTANDING_MODEL` selects a ModelArk model supporting Chat Completions `input_audio` with deep thinking; other compatible, authorized IDs may be configured.

models.name: Seed 2.0 Lite (audio understanding)

hitem3d_create_task.selection: Omit `model` for `HITEM3D_DEFAULT_MODEL`, or pass an exact ID bound to `hitem3d` in `SEED3D_MODEL_BINDINGS`.

models.capabilities: Image plus audio to talking-avatar video; asynchronous tasks polled with `omnihuman_get_task`.
